vegueros-cuba--linea-clasica.description: Introduced in 1996 and named for the growers of Pinar del Río, Vegueros is rolled at the Francisco Donatién factory there, with wrapper, binder and filler all from the Vuelta Abajo. A later renewal brought the Tapados, Entretiempos, Mañanitas and the new Centrofinos in metal tins of 16. The smoke is earthy and woody with cream and spice, pepper rising late.

thirds.notes: Wood and earth with a hint of cream and spice; better examples add cocoa and cinnamon, young ones a grassy edge.
Earth and wood lead and the spice calms, the profile holding steady.
Spice and pepper move forward with wood and cream, and the last puffs can turn bitter.

sources.title: Cigars by the Box – Vegueros Centrofinos review
